The additional evidence beyond Voyager's source comparison is the cycle-level formula and the exact hypotheses for associativity and commutativity. The [rendered definition and source](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L82) use the genuine singular homology cross product, then coefficient multiplication, then the continuous multiplication of the same topological monoid. [Hatcher §3.C, printed p.287](https://pi.math.cornell.edu/~hatcher/AT/AT.pdf#page=295) describes this composite and explains why associativity or commutativity of the multiplication is needed. Here `MonObj G` and `MonObj R` supply strict associativity; the commutativity theorem additionally requires both monoid objects commutative and the coefficient category braided. Thus the graded sign is `(-1)^(p*q)`; there is no unsupported claim that every H-space has a commutative product.

Checks at the site's commit: the [cycle formula](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L105), [space naturality](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L143), [coefficient naturality](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L172), [associativity](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L195), and [graded commutativity](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/Singular/Pontryagin.lean#L262) all pass the inspected source and transitive axiom audit, without sorry. These are listed as named tests. The [roadmap Stage5 item4](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/AlgebraicTopology/README.md#L907) is the exterior-power calculation for tori; this product is a prerequisite, not that entire calculation, and the item prescribes no additional tagged Check for this definition. The acceptance does not assert the exterior-power comparison or a unit theorem.

Naturals `p,q,n` and `p+q=n` include degree zero and exclude an ill-graded output. The unit of a monoid object excludes an empty carrier, as expected. The concrete [topological-monoid instances](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Topology/Category/TopCat/MonObj.lean#L38) use actual multiplication and continuous homomorphisms, so the abstract input is nonvacuous. Cokernel-preservation assumptions are retained explicitly; associativity uses their uniform version. The construction specifies its maps and involves no arbitrary choice of multiplication or representatives. Checked all eight semantic axes. No local rebuild claimed.
The actual product sends classes of cycles to the image of their shuffle product under the two multiplication chain maps.
Naturality uses the induced map of an actual morphism of monoid objects.
Changing monoid-object coefficients commutes with the product.
Associativity holds with no sign under the stated uniform cokernel-preservation assumptions.
The braiding swaps factors with sign (-1)^(p*q), with both monoid objects commutative.

Beyond Voyager's existing statement comparison, I checked the base independence and the nonredundant classification list in the [actual theorem and its comparison lemma](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/FiniteType/RationalClassification.lean#L49). The conclusion gives a unique valid **type**, with existence of a root-pairing equivalence; it does not assert a unique isomorphism. The equivalence respects both the roots and coroot pairing, so it cannot silently identify Bₙ with its dual Cₙ. The existential base used in the proof is removed through [HasCartanType.of_base](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/Weyl/CartanType.lean#L71).

The [Layer 5 summit and classification-list check](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/RepresentationTheory/RootSystems/README.md#L350) pass through existing proved comparisons: [rationalRootSystem and its base](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/SimplyConnectedRootDatum/Rational.lean#L78) realize every valid type, with genuine spanning root-system, reducedness and irreducibility instances; [hasCartanType_rationalRootSystem](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/SimplyConnectedRootDatum/Rational.lean#L198) identifies each model's actual Cartan matrix. The model dispatcher uses the explicit coordinate root data. [Valid](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/DynkinType.lean#L153) has the required bounds A≥1, B≥2, C≥3, D≥4 and the five exceptional types, excluding the low-rank duplications. [isSimplyLaced_cartanMatrix_iff_of_valid](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/DynkinType.lean#L383) supplies exactly A/D/E; the oriented Cartan-matrix comparison preserves the distinction between B and C. These are composite checks using existing results, not a claim that a new standalone classification fixture exists. The separate Aₙ/G₂ Weyl-group and length computations do not govern this isomorphism-classification declaration.

For an accessible primary comparison, [Čap, §3.10, printed pp.54–55](https://www.mat.univie.ac.at/~cap/files/LieAlgebras.pdf#page=60) gives the same rank ranges and explains why matching simple-root Cartan data determines a root-system isomorphism. Its Euclidean formulation becomes the rational root-pairing formulation here by the inspected algebraic rigidity theorem; no integral root-lattice/weight-lattice equality is inferred.

Checked all eight axes: the intended finite rational objects and oriented conventions; nonempty/irreducible and low-rank boundaries; no extraneous indices or empty-system vacuity; independence from base choice; explicit ℚ scope; and the classification name. The inspected statements and source proofs contain no sorry. No fresh compilation or newly fetched transitive axiom audit is claimed.
Identifies equivalence to a concrete rational model with equality of the uniquely classified Dynkin type.
Removes dependence on the choice of simple-root base through the native Weyl action.
Every valid type is realized by the actual rational coordinate root system, with its actual Cartan matrix.
The classification-list check singles out exactly A, D and E among valid Dynkin types.

The additional issue checked is the precise meaning of “no holes.” [filledHull](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Topology/FilledHull.lean#L83) contains x when its component in Uᶜ is bounded. For x∈U that component is empty, so [U⊆filledHull U](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Topology/FilledHull.lean#L91) always holds; consequently the displayed reverse inclusion says exactly that no point outside U belongs to a bounded complementary component. It does not accidentally demand connectedness of the planar complement: for an open strip, the two complementary half-planes are both unbounded. The sphere complement, with its point at infinity, is the connected object in [Rudin, Real and Complex Analysis, Theorem13.11(d)](https://absinthe.tuxfamily.net/openmathdep/analysis_complex/Real_and_Complex_Analysis-Rudin.pdf). The searched primary-source excerpt places simple connectivity in (b), so the earlier review’s “(a)⇔(d)” numbering is not the direct statement.

The [native theorem](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/SimplyConnected.lean#L114) uses Mathlib’s IsSimplyConnected on the subtype, not a replacement definition. Openness and connectedness are essential domain hypotheses; IsConnected also excludes the empty set. The whole plane is allowed and correctly has filled hull equal to itself. Unbounded domains and arbitrarily complicated closed complements are included, without a Jordan-boundary or boundedness assumption. No selected complementary component or analytic branch enters the proposition.

Exact-name search found no roadmap entry. The topic falls under [ConformalMapping’s native simple-connectivity convention](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/ConformalMapping/README.md#L78) and [L5 filled-hull topology](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/ConformalMapping/README.md#L124); neither specifies separate tagged Checks for this equivalence. Both native directions are present without sorry: [IsSimplyConnected.filledHull_subset](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/SimplyConnected.lean#L88) and [isSimplyConnected_of_filledHull_subset](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/SimplyConnected.lean#L81). The [Jordan-domain specialization](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/Conformal/Jordan/Domain.lean#L226) supplies an additional application check. All eight axes checked. Source proofs were inspected, not rebuilt; the Rudin theorem excerpt was retrieved, while the full PDF fetch timed out.
Forward direction uses native simple connectivity and excludes bounded complementary components.

Native bounded Jordan domains satisfy the simple-connectivity consequence.

Additional evidence beyond Voyager’s definition comparison: [SciPy’s primary documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.nct.html) confirms that the noncentrality is signed δ∈ℝ and the degrees of freedom may be any positive real. In the [actual definition](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L64), the product measure supplies independence, Gaussian variance is one, and division is by √(V/ν). Thus δ is not mistakenly squared or treated as an external location shift. The zero measure at ν≤0 is explicit; there is no hidden probability claim in that invalid branch.

For [StandardDistributions §10.6 and the Layer10 Checks](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/StandardDistributions/README.md#L1634), the directly applicable zero-noncentrality Check passes: [noncentralTMeasure_zero_noncentrality](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L125) gives the actual Student t measure, including the common invalid-degree convention. Additional native Checks pass: [probability iff ν>0](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L105), [reflection δ↦−δ](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L133), [squaring to noncentral F(1,ν,δ²)](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L154), and [absolute continuity](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L179). The [positive denominator theorem](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/ChiSquared/Basic.lean#L256) ensures totalized division cannot alter the valid law on a positive-measure set. The [HasLaw construction](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Probability/Distributions/NoncentralT/Basic.lean#L251) tests the definition against independent random variables on an arbitrary source space. All cited proofs are present without sorry; they were source-inspected, not locally rebuilt.

The remaining Layer10 Checks concern other distributions (central chi/chi-squared/F/Beta reductions, Nakagami, folding, and repeated or inactive rates). They are not tests of this t-law definition. Later density/cdf/moment/quantile developments are separate targets. All eight axes were checked: the construction is choice-free, nonvacuous for every ν>0, and its name/docstring accurately delimit the generality and junk branch. The cited Johnson–Kotz–Balakrishnan book was not independently consulted.
Layer10 zero-noncentrality Check: actual Student t law, including invalid degrees.
Probability exactly for positive real degrees of freedom.
Signed noncentrality reverses under reflection.
Square has noncentral F(1,ν,δ²), including invalid-degree zero laws.
No hidden atoms from the ratio construction.
The denominator is positive almost everywhere at valid degrees.
Native independent Gaussian/chi-square variables push forward to this measure.

Beyond Voyager's comparison, I checked the permutation of slots, dimension normalization, and hypotheses behind the cyclic and constant-curvature claims. The [definition](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L105) subtracts the derivative in the second slot from the derivative in the third slot of the same Schouten tensor. [Lee, §7, equation(7.49), printed p.219](https://lps.elte.hu/gomori/spacetime-geometry/readings/%28Graduate%20texts%20in%20mathematics%20176%29%20Lee%2C%20John%20M%20-%20Introduction%20to%20Riemannian%20manifolds%20%28Corrected%20version%20of%20second%20edition%29-Springer%20Nature%20%282018%29.pdf) uses precisely this slot convention. The [Schouten definition](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Schouten.lean#L67) includes the factor `1/(n−2)`, so this is the normalized Cotton tensor, not the convention scaled by `n−2`.

The [Yamabe Y0.5 target](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/Yamabe/README.md#L87) specifies this formula. The applicable definition/symmetry checks pass: [evaluation](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L117), [antisymmetry in the last two slots](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L123), [the usual vector-field derivative formula for a smooth metric](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L149), and [cyclic sum zero](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L180). The cyclic theorem explicitly assumes metric compatibility and zero torsion. [Constant sectional curvature](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/CovariantDerivative/Curvature/Cotton.lean#L213) gives zero Cotton tensor for `n≥3`, through `P=(κ/2)g` and metric compatibility, with κ constant on the entire manifold. These source theorems have standard transitive axioms and no sorry. The further conformal-change, divergence and local-conformal-flatness theorems in Y0.5 are separate development goals, not assertions made by this definition or the cited symmetry checks; this review does not certify them. No additional tagged Check is prescribed for the definition.

The definition is deliberately total beyond the classical smooth Levi-Civita, `n≥3` setting: nonsmooth Schouten fields can give the documented zero derivative, and dimension2 gives the totalized zero Schouten tensor. Those values must not be used as a conformal-flatness criterion. The vector-field formula adds the required smoothness; the definition does not hide it as an assumption-free geometric assertion. All maps are on the actual tangent fibers, with finite-dimensional continuous bilinear derivatives; no independent replacement tensor or chosen coordinates enter. Checked all eight axes, including empty manifolds, dimension boundaries, junk values, nonvacuity of the classical specialization, choice, scope and naming. Read the exact site's source and prior reason; no local rebuild claimed.
Evaluation fixes C(u,v,w)=∇_wP(u,v)−∇_vP(u,w).
Swapping the last two arguments changes the sign.
The definition agrees with the ordinary covariant-derivative formula on differentiable vector fields for a smooth metric.
The cyclic identity retains metric compatibility and torsion-free hypotheses.
Actual constant curvature in dimension at least3 implies the actual Cotton tensor vanishes.

Beyond the earlier reference match, the key hypothesis audit is that weak scalar holomorphy is the only regularity assumption on f: neither norm continuity nor local boundedness is smuggled in. [Rudin §3.30 and Theorem3.31(c), pp82–83](https://uomustansiriyah.edu.iq/media/lectures/9/9_2019_01_15!12_49_40_AM.pdf#page=99) actually treats complex Fréchet spaces; this declaration correctly states the complete normed-space specialization. StrongDual means all continuous complex-linear scalar functionals, not merely a selected separating family. Their norm topology adds no hidden uniformity assumption: the premise quantifies over their elements.

The [source](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/WeaklyHolomorphic.lean#L103) obtains norm continuity from weak holomorphy, then identifies f locally with its Banach-valued Cauchy integral by dual separation. This checks the crucial order of operations: completeness is available when the vector-valued integral is formed. On an open subset of ℂ, the norm derivative in Rudin agrees with Lean’s complex Fréchet differentiability. The ambient function ℂ→E imposes no regularity outside U; an empty or disconnected open U is allowed, and the zero Banach space is harmless. There is no choice-dependent object in the conclusion.

Exact-name search found no roadmap locator; topic search identifies [BanachAlgebras A2’s explicit weak-holomorphy target](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/BanachAlgebras/README.md#L211), which specifies no separate tagged Checks. Its requested continuity and converse are witnessed without sorry by [continuousOn_of_forall_dual](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/WeaklyHolomorphic.lean#L66) and [differentiableOn_iff_forall_dual](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/WeaklyHolomorphic.lean#L137); the [entire-function equivalence](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/Analysis/Complex/WeaklyHolomorphic.lean#L144) checks the full-domain specialization. These are recorded as supporting tests, not invented mandatory fixtures. All eight axes checked; proofs were inspected in the indexed source, not locally rebuilt.
Weak holomorphy yields actual norm continuity without assuming it.
Converse plus forward direction on the same arbitrary open set.
Full-domain entire-function specialization.

Lean's injective FreeGroup.lift is exactly freeness of the two stated integral transvections. The [proof](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/Linear.lean#L62) checks their action for every nonzero integer power: (x,y)↦(x+2my,y) and its coordinate-reversed counterpart exchange the disjoint strict cones. The witness (1,0) excludes vacuity. This matches [Sapir, §1.8.7, Theorem 1.8.31](https://www.math.vanderbilt.edu/~msapir/book/b2.pdf).

Both [§5.8 calibrations](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/FreeGroupsAndLimitGroups/README.md#L1288) pass. The [actual bⁱab⁻ⁱ embedding](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/Linear.lean#L118) handles every finite rank, including zero; the adjacent theorem supplies countable rank. For the commutator, AB=[[5,2],[2,1]], so tr(A),tr(B),tr(AB)=2,2,6. The published [Fricke formula](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Trace/FinTwo.lean#L231) gives tr(ABA⁻¹B⁻¹)=4+4+36−24−2=18≠2. This explicitly evaluates existing native formulas; no separate trace-18 fixture is claimed. Negative powers, matrix conventions and integral scope were checked. Inspected proofs contain no sorry; no fresh compilation is claimed.
The actual native free-group lift is injective from nonempty disjoint cones and all nonzero integer powers.
Integer powers retain the actual transvection action with parameter multiplied by the exponent, including negative exponents.
The exact b^i a b^(-i) words yield the required finite-rank embeddings, by distinct integer exponents.
The same construction gives an actual injective homomorphism for any countable free basis.
The prescribed commutator check follows by substituting the computed native matrix traces 2,2,6, giving 18 rather than 2.

The [class fields](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/RingTheory/RegularLocalRing/RegularAlgebraMap.lean#L46) express flatness and geometric regularity of each native fibre κ(p)⊗R B. Noetherianity is required of these fibres through GeometricallyRegular, matching [Stacks Definition15.42.1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07BY), without imposing finite presentation on the map.

Beyond the existing review, all three applicable [§0.21 Checks](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/SchemeAndStackFoundations/README.md#L1437) are [proved anonymous examples](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/RingTheory/RegularLocalRing/RegularAlgebraMap.lean#L106): identity, zero target, and flat dual numbers failing regularity. The negative example uses the field comparison and a nonzero square-zero element. ℤ→ℚ also confirms the intended scope beyond finite-presentation maps. Fibre-presentation independence is proved by algebra-equivalence transport. Separate excellence Checks do not apply to this definition. Source inspected; no local compilation claimed, and no test names invented for anonymous examples.

Correctly stated: [Lean’s equality](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/KnotTheory/BraidWord/Jones.lean#L118) says the Jones representation’s trace equals δ times the normalized Kauffman bracket of the actual braid closure, where δ=−(a²+a⁻²). This matches [Lickorish, Ch.3, Definitions3.1/3.4/3.6](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCetiRoadmap/blob/eafdde47e47e067afa9c64faddc70703a69c7c56/TauCetiRoadmap/GeometricTopology/references/lickorish-jones.md). The factor δ is retained, so no cancellation or integral-domain assumption is needed; a is a unit in any commutative ring. The [polynomial version](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/KnotTheory/BraidWord/Jones.lean#L143) uses precisely t^(1/2)=a⁻². Checks pass: the [one-strand trace is δ and trefoil trace is δ(a⁻⁴+a⁻¹²−a⁻¹⁶)](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/KnotTheory/TemperleyLieb.lean#L333), matching the [diagram values 1 and t+t³−t⁴](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/KnotTheory/PDCode/Jones/Basic.lean#L287). The actual closure’s [empty-word, added-strand and skein identities](https://github.com/TauCetiProject/TauCeti/blob/271e1af4dd54c50b9192cf3e213b7686843a0b3a/TauCeti/KnotTheory/BraidWord/Jones.lean) are also proved.
